info.name: SaaS Model API
info.description:
Multi-tenant B2B SaaS management platform API. Import this collection, run 'Auth > Login' first (it auto-saves the JWT into the {{token}} collection variable), then every other request is authenticated automatically via the collection's Bearer Auth setting.

Most list/create endpoints for org-owned resources take an `organizationId` query param / body field. It is REQUIRED for platform staff (SUPER_ADMIN / SAAS_STAFF) and IGNORED for an ORG_USER, who is always scoped to their own organization automatically.

request.description: Authenticates and returns a JWT. The test script below saves it into the {{token}} collection variable so every other request is authenticated automatically.
